name: I2 molecular crystal, low temperature (CIF100K; article110K)
citation: F. Bertolotti, A. V. Shishkina, A. Forni, G. Gervasio, A. I. Stash and V. G. Tsirelson (2014). Intermolecular Bonding Features in Solid Iodine. Crystal Growth & Design14(7),3587-3595.

measurement_temperature_conflict.resolution: Unresolved; numeric measurement temperature intentionallynull. Exact CIF retained.

measurement_conditions_evidence: Both original SI/COD CIF tags verified against the authored primary article Experimental and Results text. Contradiction is documented, not silently reconciled.
method: Experimental low-temperature single-crystal high-resolution MoK-alpha X-ray diffraction on Gemini R Ultra, followed by experimental multipole/anharmonic refinement; exact deposited experimental nuclear coordinates selected.
synthesis_conditions: Commercial solid iodine was sublimed at room temperature to grow single crystals; no numeric growth temperature reported. This is separate from the conflicting low-temperature diffraction values.
notes: Measurement-temperature conflict is unresolved: the original publisher SI CIF and unchanged COD file state100(2)K, but the primary article Experimental Section states110(1)K and its Results repeats110K for this identical cell. The numeric measurement-temperature field is null; both reported values remain explicit. No temperature correction or rescaling is applied.

Selected first intramolecular I-I shell only: one neighbor at2.717798A, cutoff3.0A. This is not a complete description of molecular-crystal packing: the next intermolecular contacts are2x3.500960A and1x3.979707A, excluded from this shell selection and retained in the structural inspection.
This is elemental molecular iodine, not iodide or an iodine oxide reference. No oxidation-state equivalence to salts is implied.
The exact experimental multipole-refined coordinates in the publisher SI CIF reproduce the same structure as the COD file. DFT-D/MP2 optimized geometries from the same article are not used.

COD normalized the formula/Z representation fromI/Z8 toI2/Z4; the raw formula-weight field remains126.90. This bookkeeping inconsistency does not alter the8-atom cell or geometry. The source file is preserved unchanged.

The published experimental bond length2.7179(2)A agrees with the2.717798A distance calculated directly from this CIF; the main-paper Table2 also prints2.710A. The exact source coordinates, rather than a manually replaced tabular bond, determine the FEFF geometry.

K-edge selected for broad EXAFS coverage; I K edge is33169eV in installedXrayDB. I L3 at4557eV is followed by L2 at4852eV (295eV, k8.799A^-1), so the L3 alternative has a close next-edge boundary. A computed k20 grid does not establish usable data.

Native FEFF spherical-potential paths do not reproduce the source multipole electron density, halogen-bond energy, anisotropic/anharmonic displacement model, or experimental XANES simply by using the same geometry.
